intent: Explain progressive income taxation by showing that higher-income groups pay a larger share of their income in taxes than lower-income groups.

requirements.question: How does the effective income-tax rate change across income groups?

units.claim: The income-tax rate rises across the ten income deciles, from the lowest rate for the poorest group to the highest rate for the richest 10%.
accept: ten ordered income deciles are shown
the richest 10% is the highest bar
the poorest 10% is substantially lower than the richest 10%
reject: presenting the richest group as the lowest
units.evidence: Use the corresponding visible bars/segments in the selected keyframe.

g0_data_completeness.selection: all role=bar bars or stack segments; annotation rows excluded
